rachel_fin: Flagging invoice INV-2024-512 — unexpected public egress $2,450. Renewal auto-renews 2024-12-20. @dave_procure @sara_eng please triage.

dave_procure: Can you paste the invoice line items? I'll ask LedgerBridge for detail and a one-time credit.

rachel_fin: "INV-2024-512 Total $40,870 — Network egress (public): $2,450"

billingbot: Invoice INV-2024-512 posted 2024-10-07. Due 2024-11-06.

sara_eng: We flipped export to a public bucket on Sep 14 for audit logs; likely cause. We can reconfigure to a VPC S3 endpoint to avoid public egress.

connor_ops: If we're migrating to the connector, need a capped ramp to avoid billing spikes during cutover. Ask LedgerBridge for a 90-day cap + ramp.

alex_ledgerbridge: Hi all 94 Alex from LedgerBridge. Sorry about the charge. We can offer: (1) one-time migration credit for $2,450 applied to INV-2024-512, (2) 90-day egress cap with ramp proposed $700 / $1,400 / $2,100, (3) waive connector setup fee for a pilot, and (4) provide SKU-level invoice with migration credit line. We'll send an updated SOW and sample invoice.

dave_procure: Please include the ramp and credit in the SOW and confirm connector supports streaming with backpressure and configurable max outstanding bytes. Need clear invoice format for PO.

maria_legal: Legal will review SOW. We require an egress responsibility clause, 30-day cure for SLA breaches, and a data portability clause. Will provide redlines after SOW.

rachel_fin: Finance will approve payment once the credit is applied to INV-2024-512 and SOW terms are acceptable. Please send SOW today if possible.

alex_ledgerbridge: Understood. I'll circulate the revised SOW (including ramp, credit, waived setup fee, SKU invoice sample, and connector config/backpressure example) within 4 business hours.

dave_procure: I'll prepare PO routing. If exec sign-off is needed I'll escalate to Tom.

rachel_fin: Thanks everyone 94 flagging for follow-up. :thumbsup:
